home.section: Home, me, search and the shell (Phase 2 — sso-shell)
home.when: the start: the search box with Search and Ask, certified products, my recent and followed datasets, popular this month, open incidents on datasets I use, decisions waiting for me; engineers: failed loads, late datasets, the Steward's proposals; the admin: the engine, storage, the last backup and drill; a new person's one button, Upload a spreadsheet

search.section: Home, me, search and the shell (Phase 2 — sso-shell)
search.when: the catalog search's results as cards — certified first, stubs for what I may not discover

notifications.section: Home, me, search and the shell (Phase 2 — sso-shell)

activity.section: Home, me, search and the shell (Phase 2 — sso-shell)

settings.section: Home, me, search and the shell (Phase 2 — sso-shell)
settings.when: my preferences: which notices by email and by text, the digest

settings-tokens.section: Home, me, search and the shell (Phase 2 — sso-shell)
settings-tokens.when: my MCP tokens and my API keys (with the SQL switch): mint (shown once), rotate, revoke

browse.when: the lake by zone, by department and by tag, as cards with certification, health, owner and "data updated"

dataset-view.when: one dataset: the header (crumbs, badge, health, owner and steward, data and metadata updated, rows, size, Query this, Request access, Follow); tabs About, Columns, Preview, Quality, Lineage, Usage, Access, History — by anchor; a stub shows the name, the owner and Request access only

dataset-add.when: to register a curated or product dataset before a promotion or a transform makes it: zone, name, title, owner, steward, department, the contract's key

dataset-edit.when: to describe a dataset (title, description, purpose, usage, limitations), set its owner, steward, department, tier, freshness expectations, schema-evolution mode, status, the deprecation note and successor

column-view.when: one column: its meaning, type, classification and personal kind, the glossary term, the reference, the profile over time

column-edit.when: to describe a column: business name, description, glossary term, critical, the dataset and column it references

glossary.when: the business glossary: terms by category, draft and approved

term-view.when: one term: definition, synonyms, the columns that carry it

term-edit.when: to change a term's definition, synonyms, category, steward

tags.when: the tag vocabulary: managed and free, counts, colours

upload.section: Uploads, loads and the sandbox (slice 2 — THE FIRST EXEMPLAR)
upload.when: to drop files (CSV, TSV, XLSX, XLS, ODS, JSON, NDJSON, Parquet — up to 5 GB, sent in parts) and see each land

upload-map.section: Uploads, loads and the sandbox (slice 2 — THE FIRST EXEMPLAR)
upload-map.when: the mapping: the first 50 rows, each column's name, type and personal-data proposal, the sheet and header row, the target (my sandbox, or an engineer's raw dataset, append or replace), the key; save as a template

sandbox.section: Uploads, loads and the sandbox (slice 2 — THE FIRST EXEMPLAR)
sandbox.when: my sandbox datasets and my quota

load-list.section: Uploads, loads and the sandbox (slice 2 — THE FIRST EXEMPLAR)
load-list.when: loads by dataset, source and status

load-view.section: Uploads, loads and the sandbox (slice 2 — THE FIRST EXEMPLAR)
load-view.when: one load: counts, the schema seen, drift, rescued fields, the checks' outcome, the rejected lines (their raw text at write level), rollback

templates.section: Uploads, loads and the sandbox (slice 2 — THE FIRST EXEMPLAR)
templates.when: saved mappings for files that come back every month

sql.section: The query service, the SQL editor, saved queries and exports (slice 3 — THE SECOND EXEMPLAR)
sql.when: the editor (desk): the datasets I may read, the editor with completion of their keys, Run and Cancel, the result with the display cap and the truncation notice, quick column stats, Save, Download, Save as dataset, my recent runs; a refusal names its rule and offers Request access

queries.section: The query service, the SQL editor, saved queries and exports (slice 3 — THE SECOND EXEMPLAR)
queries.when: saved queries: mine and shared, the Verified badge

query-view.section: The query service, the SQL editor, saved queries and exports (slice 3 — THE SECOND EXEMPLAR)
query-view.when: one saved query: its question, SQL, parameters, the datasets it reads, verified by whom; Run shows the result only

query-edit.section: The query service, the SQL editor, saved queries and exports (slice 3 — THE SECOND EXEMPLAR)
query-edit.when: to change a saved query's title, question, SQL, parameters, sharing

query-run-view.section: The query service, the SQL editor, saved queries and exports (slice 3 — THE SECOND EXEMPLAR)
query-run-view.when: one query run: the SQL (mine, or all for the audit), datasets, masks, row filters, rows, time, status

exports.section: The query service, the SQL editor, saved queries and exports (slice 3 — THE SECOND EXEMPLAR)
exports.when: my exports: ready, expired, the rows and whether some columns were masked

my-access.section: Access, policies, groups and personal data (slice 4)
my-access.when: what I may read and through what; my requests

requests.section: Access, policies, groups and personal data (slice 4)
requests.when: requests: tabs Mine, To decide, History — approve with a level and an optional expiry, or deny with a reason

request-add.section: Access, policies, groups and personal data (slice 4)
request-add.when: to ask for access to a dataset: the level and the reason

grants.section: Access, policies, groups and personal data (slice 4)
grants.when: the grants on a dataset, a zone or a tag

grant-add.section: Access, policies, groups and personal data (slice 4)
grant-add.when: to grant a level on a dataset, a zone or a tag to a person, a group, a department, an agent or everyone — with a row filter and an expiry

groups.section: Access, policies, groups and personal data (slice 4)
groups.when: groups as cards: custom and department mirrors

group-view.section: Access, policies, groups and personal data (slice 4)
group-view.when: one group: members, owners, the grants it holds

group-add.section: Access, policies, groups and personal data (slice 4)
group-add.when: to make a group: custom, or mirroring a department

group-edit.section: Access, policies, groups and personal data (slice 4)
group-edit.when: to rename a group or change its description

policies.section: Access, policies, groups and personal data (slice 4)
policies.when: the masks: each personal kind and classification and how it is masked below read_unmasked

personal-data.section: Access, policies, groups and personal data (slice 4)
personal-data.when: the personal-data map: columns by kind, proposed and confirmed — confirm or reject

admin-read.section: Access, policies, groups and personal data (slice 4)
admin-read.when: the admin's break-glass: open a dataset's rows for an hour with a reason

quality.section: Contracts, promotion, checks, incidents and certification (slice 5 — THE THIRD EXEMPLAR)
quality.when: the lake's health: failing checks today, late datasets, open incidents — at 375 a status list

incident-list.section: Contracts, promotion, checks, incidents and certification (slice 5 — THE THIRD EXEMPLAR)
incident-list.when: incidents by status, severity and assignee

incident-view.section: Contracts, promotion, checks, incidents and certification (slice 5 — THE THIRD EXEMPLAR)
incident-view.when: one incident: its check and the result that opened it, the Steward's triage, the notes, what it reaches downstream; acknowledge, assign, note, resolve

checks.section: Contracts, promotion, checks, incidents and certification (slice 5 — THE THIRD EXEMPLAR)
checks.when: a dataset's checks with their last results and the 7-day strip

check-add.section: Contracts, promotion, checks, incidents and certification (slice 5 — THE THIRD EXEMPLAR)
check-add.when: to add a check from a template: not null, unique, accepted values, range, regex, row count, freshness, referential, schema, custom SQL

check-edit.section: Contracts, promotion, checks, incidents and certification (slice 5 — THE THIRD EXEMPLAR)
check-edit.when: to change a check's parameters, severity, blocking, schedule

contract-view.section: Contracts, promotion, checks, incidents and certification (slice 5 — THE THIRD EXEMPLAR)
contract-view.when: the dataset's contract: the typed schema, the key, the SLA, the versions, the ODCS download

contract-edit.section: Contracts, promotion, checks, incidents and certification (slice 5 — THE THIRD EXEMPLAR)
contract-edit.when: to draft the next version: columns and types, required, unique, the key, the ordering column, the SLA — breaking changes shown, with their impact

quarantine.section: Contracts, promotion, checks, incidents and certification (slice 5 — THE THIRD EXEMPLAR)
quarantine.when: the rows promotion held back, with their reasons (at write level; masked below)

source-list.when: sources as cards: connector, schedule, last pull, state, why paused

source-view.when: one source: its settings (never the credential, its last four only), the pulls with their counts, the datasets it feeds; Test, Pull now, Pause

source-add.when: to add a source: the connector's form — a file at a URL, an SFTP directory, a sibling's share through the kernel, an outside PostgreSQL database — the target dataset and the schedule

source-edit.when: to change a source's settings, target, schedule, rate

products.when: the product gallery: certified products first, their owners, freshness and metrics

transform-list.when: transforms: output, inputs, mode, schedule, last run

transform-view.when: one transform: the SQL, inputs and output, mode, schedule, the frozen level, the runs, the lineage it makes

transform-add.when: to write a transform (desk): the output dataset, the SQL over dataset keys, mode, schedule

transform-edit.when: to change a transform's SQL, mode or schedule (a new version)

metric-list.when: metrics: certified first, their product, grains and dimensions

metric-view.when: one metric: its definition, its value by month as a small chart, the dimensions to cut by

metric-add.when: to define a metric over a product

metric-edit.when: to change a metric's expression, time column, grains, dimensions, filters

lineage-graph.when: the lineage graph (desk): two hops up and down as an SVG; nodes I may not discover counted, unnamed

retention.when: retention by zone and by dataset, the landing window, the audit's windows

erasure-add.when: to ask the lake to forget a person: the identifiers by kind, the reason, the scope

erasure-view.when: one erasure: the scan's report (datasets, rows, zones, what downstream loses rows, which loads become not replayable), the warning that time travel ends for every dataset, approve (another admin), the progress, the proof

maintenance.when: storage by dataset and zone, quotas, the last maintenance passes, the writer's queue; run maintenance now

backups.when: the last backups and restore drills, their checks; run a drill

connections.section: The lake's API, keys and the K7 shares (slice 9)
connections.when: the siblings: what the lake reads from them (K7 sources, their last pull, no_connection) and what it shares with them (products and metrics granted to each application, their reads)

api.section: The lake's API, keys and the K7 shares (slice 9)
api.when: the lake's API: the routes, my keys' limits and the SQL switch, examples with my own key's last four

ask.section: Agents, the Steward, notifications, home and admin (slice 10)
ask.when: to ask the lake in words: the conversation with the expert through the kernel's chat endpoint; each answer with the interpretation, the result as a table or a simple chart, Show SQL, the datasets and the metric or verified query used, the query run, a note when columns were masked; Yes / Fix it / Ask a steward

steward.section: Agents, the Steward, notifications, home and admin (slice 10)
steward.when: the Steward's inbox: drafted descriptions, personal data, owners, checks, drift, unused, promotion — accept, edit or dismiss with the diff

coverage.section: Agents, the Steward, notifications, home and admin (slice 10)
coverage.when: coverage against the target by tier and department: described, owned, classified, checked, certified

admin-settings.section: Agents, the Steward, notifications, home and admin (slice 10)
admin-settings.when: the lake's settings: windows, quotas, the upload ceiling, the masking salt's id, the certification target

admin-limits.section: Agents, the Steward, notifications, home and admin (slice 10)
admin-limits.when: the query service's limits: timeouts, rows shown and downloaded, result bytes, workers, memory, concurrency, the agents' rate

query-audit.section: Agents, the Steward, notifications, home and admin (slice 10)
query-audit.when: every query run: who, on whose behalf, which agent, which datasets, masks, rows, status — the SQL for the audit

engine.section: Agents, the Steward, notifications, home and admin (slice 10)
engine.when: the engine: the writer's queue and running jobs, the query service's runs, refusals and timeouts today, the last snapshot

agents-settings.section: Agents, the Steward, notifications, home and admin (slice 10)
agents-settings.when: the agents: which is the Steward, the duty's hour, the daily proposal cap, the dispatches
